ambiguities_or_notes: Every source block (20) has a matching target block, with page markers, numbering, quotation structure, and italics preserved.

Website Circle of Reading paragraphs served as the first draft; each was re-read against the Russian and revised where it drifted (omissions, additions, generic he/his, terminology, attribution form); blocks 16 had no website counterpart and were translated fresh.

Mazzini's «наше я» (nashe ya, 'our I') keeps Tolstoy's italics as 'our *I*', and «похоти личности» (pokhoti lichnosti) is 'the lusts of personality' per the terminology ledger; Goethe's «свойственно» (svoystvenno, 'proper to') is kept literal. Restored clauses the website draft had dropped («и когда», 'and when'; «возможности», 'of the possibility'); «Иосиф Мадзини» (Iosif Madzini) is Giuseppe Mazzini and «Карлейл» (Karleyl) is Carlyle.

Source observation: [15–16] The Carlyle passage and its attribution are not set as a quotation (no «>»), unlike the other attributed readings, and the name is spelled «Карлейл» rather than the usual «Карлейль»; reproduced as printed (unquoted).
